status: Early proposed M1 route-intent presentation; exact new contracts/samples pending

draft.title: Route preview
draft.hint: Right-click sets the destination. Shift + right-click adds a waypoint.
draft.queueLimit: Portable/frontend contract dependency; never silently truncate
draft.costs: Returned per-leg and total costs; crossing count separate; unavailable total for incomplete route
draft.persistence: Local review draft only if explicit host contract is supplied; never mutate generated map JSON or campaign saves

markers.automaticTransitNodes: No numbered markers, visit rings or survey effects
markers.overlap: Ordered inspector plus zoom, no geometry displacement or renumbering

line.baseline: Taut contained polyline through accepted ordered portal corridor; only true start/end and explicit pins fixed
line.smoothing: Optional only after verified containment and crossing order; no random/unconstrained spline
line.failure: Show actual invalid leg reason without bridging or silently skipping it

intent.transit: Corridor or user-pinned transit anchor; no POI action implied
intent.starLocation: A chosen position is not an explicit visit/survey command
intent.visitAction: Future separate authoritative contract; not introduced in map review
intent.automaticSystemRegion: Passing through its region does not pin its star

comparisons.drawing: Same actual corridor, anchors, nodes and costs; centre-return versus contained transit
comparisons.tieChoice: Same map/endpoints/filter context; actual supplied equal-primary-cost routes, declared secondary metric
comparisons.naturalLayout: Actual old/new seeded250 then1000 exports; different version/hash stated; identical camera/style, no marker jitter
comparisons.arity: Actual group membership if supplied; otherwise explicitly labeled geometric proxies

scope: CPU/browser art only; safe913 checkpoint and prior galleries frozen; no campaign/sensors/AI/diplomacy, paid generation, native/Unity/GPU or M2
